title: chelone obliqua subsp. typica
intro: Chelone obliqua subsp. typica, commonly known as the White Turtlehead, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Chelone obliqua subsp. typica include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
